verdict: Passed narrow actual CLI/fake-provider two-turn proof, now also through shared native-text trial with two trusted final-output markers. Not paid quality or efficiency acceptance. Original v1 results preserved.

method.entry: ordinary pi --print --mode json --session; same explicit session per arm, separate sessions between arms
method.output: plain native final text; no response schema, no MCP or reply tool
method.binding: per-Run FinalReply opt-in before launch, immutable launch id and prelaunch session bytes; current appended branch user and final response identity crosschecked
method.terminal: exit0, complete JSONL, unique final stop/raw stop, settled non-aborted with no retry, all tools settled, no late generation
method.publication: body copied unchanged via existing authenticated Worker; frozen delivered seq and original Run idempotency; receipt only then explicit Activation completion after actual Run termination

freeResults.usageCaveat: Deterministic invented fake-provider token counts verify accounting plumbing only; no efficiency/cost result.

negativeCases: real Kernel newer Human stale hold: zero post
lost HTTP response after real commit: one post, committed ACK retained; no retry, synthetic ACK or Activation completion
owned timeout: real timed_out Run, no post or ACK

memory.basis: Installed 1.1.0 source matched prior audit; no independent automatic-memory subsystem found within that bounded audit
memory.limits: Not a guarantee for future Pi versions or arbitrary extensions; no user account files copied/read.

network.osSandbox: deny outbound except loopback; actual external 1.1.1.1 socket EPERM probe passed
network.modelConfig: new isolated fake-local/fake-final with synthetic token; minimal child environment

limitations: No paid Pi model tested or admitted; synthetic replies do not establish model quality.
No long-task cost ratio or cross-model claim.
Raw stop reason validation is specific to observed OpenAI-completions fake binding; other providers require source/negative checks.
Underlying native same-user filesystem access is not a security boundary; this prototype disables automatic resources and blocks known account roots, not all possible secret paths.

Worker submission occurs after durable process-close evidence but before Kernel runtime termination, because existing Worker authorization requires live Run; this bounded controller window does not change production Kernel.
No production deployment or service restart; private prototype only.

sharedHelperV2Integration.modelOutput: unchanged plain final text; no schema/MCP reply tool; only Host serializes existing envelope
sharedHelperV2Integration.identity: Before launch freezes explicit Run intent, launchId and session-before bytes. Pi generates first session and current user entry IDs; original validator proves append-only current branch and final. These native IDs are frozen before helper construction/submission; userEntryId is the native turn identity, not a provider model-step id.
limits: Original v1 unknown/stale tests remain labeled v1; v2 full-loop success verifies shared final-output markers. Shared helper negative/mutual-exclusion tests are separate root-owned evidence, not claimed as Pi runtime scenarios.
